subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up on Friday, June 25th. Join us for a day of fun activities, team building exercises, and a delicious BBQ lunch. This event is our way of showing gratitude for all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the schedule and RSVP information. We look forward to celebrating with all of you! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
